conjecture: Cross-pivot cancellation: let P be a rank-3 exact signed idempotent (square real matrix with P^2 = P and all row sums equal to 1), let U = (u_0,u_1,u_2) be an actual-row chart whose rows p_{u_0}, p_{u_1}, p_{u_2} form a basis of the row space, and define coordinates a_q(i) by p_i = sum_q a_q(i)p_{u_q} and beta_r(i) = P_{u_r i}; then for every pair of distinct indices r, s in {0,1,2}, sum_i beta_r(i)*a_s(i) = 0, the sum running over all row indices i of P.
